rulebook.title: The Detective
rulebook.pitch: Joins a random party and turns Bugging or Investigate Loyalty into a look at the target's Secret Role card.

details.label: Setup
text: At the start of the night you draw the top card of the spare membership deck (2 Liberal, 1 Fascist, 1 Communist) and join that party.

details.label: Goal
text: You win when the party you drew wins.

details.label: Power
text: When Bugging or Investigate Loyalty comes up while you are President or Chancellor, you may reveal and take it over.
You alone choose the player. They hand you their Secret Role card instead of their membership card, and you may report it truthfully or lie. At any other time you have no power.

details.label: Danger
text: Revealing tells everyone you are the Detective, but not your party. The side your report hurts will call you a liar and may execute you.

details.label: How to play it
text: Save your reveal for the investigation that matters most: a Secret Role card can unmask Hitler or a hidden role.
